remarks: Large North Stamford Ranch, on market for the first time.  This property is situated on just over 1 acre of land, loving cared for by its' owner this home will wow you with its grand entrance, large sun-drenched living room, with custom brick fireplace, hard wood adorns the floor throughout. ensuite plus 2 additional bedrooms on main floor, bathroom, kitchen, and dining.  Additional feature, a rear deck from master bedroom stretching the length of rear overlooking natures best back yard. Downstairs includes a massive custom fireplace, huge family room leading to lower deck, great for entertainment, wet bar a 3rd bathroom, laundry and a bonus room and 2 cars garage. Bring your vision and personal touch and make this home your home for years to come.
